As a vet and a dog owner, I truly understand how painful it is to let our pets go. Our final act of love is making that decision—choosing, despite our deep affection, to let them go because it’s what’s best for them. They don’t understand what’s happening, and they’re not holding on to a life where they’re struggling every day. It’s our responsibility as pet owners to do everything we can for them, but also to recognise when it’s time to let go ❤️
